title: A two-dimensional realization of the parity anomaly
summary: Quantum anomalies arise when symmetries of a classical theory cannot be preserved upon quantization, leading to unconventional topological responses. A prominent example is the parity anomaly of a single two-dimensional Dirac fermion, which enforces a half-quantized Hall response. Anomaly inflow mechanism allows this effect to be observed at the surfaces of three-dimensional topological insulators, however, its realization in a genuinely two-dimensional system has remained elusive.
